name: gdrive_whoami
description: Verify the Google credentials this plugin is using and report which identity Drive sees. Use this first when a Drive/Docs/Sheets tool fails with a permission error, and to learn which email files must be shared with.

name: gdrive_search
description: Search Google Drive for files by name and/or full text. Filter by type (docs, sheets, slides, folders) or restrict to a folder. Returns id, type, modified time, and link for each match; pass the id to gdocs_read or gsheets_read.

query.description: Words to search for in the file name and body. Omit to list everything matching the other filters.

type.description: Restrict results to one Google file type. Default: any.

folder.description: Folder ID or Drive folder URL. Only direct children of this folder are returned.

nameOnly.description: Match the query against file names only, not document contents. Default: false.

name: gdrive_file_info
description: Get metadata for one Drive file (name, type, owner, modified time, link). For a Google Sheet, also lists its tabs with sizes. Accepts a file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

name: gdocs_read
description: Read the contents of a Google Doc as Markdown (or plain text). Also reads Google Slides (as text) and plain-text/Markdown/CSV files stored in Drive. If given a Google Sheet it returns the first tab; use gsheets_read for ranges. Long documents are paged: check `truncated` and pass startChar to continue.

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

format.description: Export format for Google Docs. Default: markdown.

startChar.description: Character offset to start from when paging. Default: 0.

name: gsheets_read
description: Read a Google Sheet. With no range, lists the tabs and returns the first tab (or the tab named by #gid= in the URL). Pass an A1 range such as "Roadmap!A1:F50" or just a tab name to read that data. Output is a Markdown table by default; use format=csv for raw values or json for a 2D array.

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

range.description: A1 notation range, e.g. "Sheet1!A1:D20", or a tab name for the whole tab. Optional.

headerRow.description: Treat the first returned row as a header in Markdown output. Default: true.

name: gdrive_comments
description: List review comments (with quoted text and replies) on a Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides file. Use to see open feedback on a document. Resolved comments are hidden unless includeResolved is true.

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

name: gsheets_write
description: Write a 2D array of values into a Google Sheet. mode=update overwrites the given A1 range; mode=append adds rows after the last row of data in the given tab/range. Values are parsed like typed input (numbers, dates, formulas starting with =).

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

range.description: A1 range to write (update) or the tab/range to append below (append), e.g. "Log!A1".

name: gdocs_append
description: Append plain text to the end of a Google Doc (a newline is inserted before it). Use for adding notes, decisions, or generated sections. Markdown is not rendered; write plain prose.

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.

name: gdrive_comment_add
description: Add a top-level (unanchored) comment to a Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides file. Use to leave review feedback that collaborators will see in the Google UI.

file.description: Drive file ID or any docs.google.com / drive.google.com URL.
